summary: amazon.aws now includes modules migrated from community.aws: autoscaling_instance_refresh(_info), ec2_launch_template, ec2_placement_group(_info), ec2_transit_gateway(_info) and transit gateway attachments. Playbooks should use the amazon.aws FQCNs.
questions: Which collection should I reference for ec2_placement_group?

answer_card.title: Modules added to amazon.aws in Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md: Use `amazon.aws.*` FQCNs for these migrated modules: `autoscaling_instance_refresh`, `autoscaling_instance_refresh_info`, `ec2_launch_template`, `ec2_placement_group`, `ec2_placement_group_info`, `ec2_transit_gateway`, `ec2_transit_gateway_info`, `ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment`.
